{{Quote|Hopefully we'll be able to intercept a few Jedi before they walk into this catastrophe.|Bail Organa speaks to Sateen Vestswe, Sheltay Retrac and Raymus Antilles|audio=Bail-Catastrophe-ROTS.flac|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Sateen Vestswe''' was a [[human]] who served as an [[aide]] to [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic]]. In [[19 BBY]], Vestswe walked with Organa through one of the corridors of the ''[[Tantive III]]'', Organa's [[consular ship]], as the senator spoke about aiding the [[Jedi]] following the Republic's issuing of [[Order 66]].

==Biography==
Sateen Vestswe was a [[human]] who served as an [[aide]] to [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]], who was a member of Alderaan's [[House of Organa]] and part of the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Alderaanian delegation]]. Organa was a member of the [[Delegation of 2,000]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], meaning that Vestswe needed to be loyal and willing to keep many secrets in order to protect the senator during such dangerous [[time]]s.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />

[[File:VestsweTantiveIII-ROTS.png|thumb|left|320px|Left to right: Sheltay Retrac, Bail Organa, Sateen Vestswe, and Raymus Antilles]]
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Vestswe was on board<ref name="ROTS" /> the ''[[Tantive III]]'', Organa's [[consular ship]],<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> as it took off from the planet [[Coruscant]] shortly after the Republic issued [[Order 66]], condemning all members of the [[Jedi Order]] as traitors. Vestwe walked down one of the ship's corridors toward the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] with Organa, [[Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles]], and<ref name="ROTS" /> the head of Organa's team of aides, [[Sheltay Retrac]],<ref name="HC34">{{HelmetCollectionCite|34|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> as the senator spoke about trying to intercept some of the surviving Jedi before they walked into a trap. Organa then went on to aid [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Personality and traits==
Vestswe had light skin, [[Color|green]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />

==Equipment==
While on the ''Tantive III'', Vestswe wore a green [[Clothing|tunic]] with a gray [[jacket]], black pants, black [[boot]]s, and a brown [[belt]] where the aide holstered a [[Kueget LN-21 blaster pistol]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LetMeSeeYourIdentification-SWcom.png|thumb|right|300px|Sateen Vestswe appeared in a scene cut from ''Revenge of the Sith''.]]
Sateen Vestswe was portrayed by [[Scott Mewett]]<ref name="Identification">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/explore/sithsnap/2005/11/sithsnap20051107.html|text=''Sith'' Snapshots: Sith Snapshots: Let Me See Your Identification}}</ref> in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The character's scene was filmed on Stage 7 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 24]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Vestswe was to appear in an additional scene that was cut from the film in which the aide and Organa found security on Coruscant increasingly hard to bypass while speaking with a member of the [[Senate Guard]].<ref name="Identification" /> The design of Senator [[Zinn Paulness]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series was based on Vestswe.<ref name="HostageCrisis">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}}</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Vestswe was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', a reference book written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="Dressing">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> and published on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/mxQvt|archivedate=2022-04-24}}</ref>
